roleZh: 连接直流端子与上下桥臂芯片，承载主功率电流；P、N 两层构成换流回路。
roleEn: Connects the DC terminals and switch groups, carrying main power current. P and N form the commutation return path.
featuresZh: P、N 层面对面叠放，电流方向相反，磁场相互抵消。间距越小、重叠越宽，平行板近似电感越低。
featuresEn: Opposing currents in closely stacked P/N plates cancel part of their magnetic fields. A smaller gap and wider overlap reduce the parallel-plate estimate.
materialZh: 无氧铜 C1020（可镀镍或镀锡）；层间绝缘为 PI 或 PEN 薄膜，边缘需绝缘设计。
materialEn: Oxygen-free copper C1020, optionally nickel or tin plated; PI or PEN dielectric film with separately designed edge insulation.
